window.note: timezone-aware ISO-8601; open the window only after every prerequisite below is closed

execution_order.rule: No R7 operation starts until R6 is ADMITTED / IN_SERVICE and `check --devices R6 R7 --completed R6:<op>...` shows no FAIL (ORDER + DEPENDENCY + UPSTREAM gates enforce it).

allowed_operations.BOOTSTRAP_AUTHORIZE: bootstrap authorization (request -> second-person approval), bounded window and use count
allowed_operations.ISOLATION_ENFORCE: isolation policy plan -> governed Change on the trusted upstream -> enforce -> verify
allowed_operations.ZTP_REBOOTSTRAP: device erase + reload into native ZTP behind the enforced isolation, DHCP via the trusted relay
allowed_operations.DHCP_RENEWAL_WINDOW: controlled re-discovery window (ztp.lease.expect_renewal) re-deciding authorization + upstream
allowed_operations.COMMISSIONING_CONFIGURE: commissioning record: configure while isolated (isolation stays VERIFIED, no drift)
allowed_operations.ADMISSION: production admission plan -> precheck -> second-person approval -> execute -> verify
allowed_operations.MANAGEMENT_PATH_APPROVE: management path register -> second-person approval (Management VRF or VLAN 200)

traffic_continuity.max_outage_rationale: proposed ceiling for the cumulative H5 interruption across both devices (R6 then R7: isolate, erase/reload into native ZTP, DHCP, commission, admit); the approver confirms or lowers it
traffic_continuity.outage_scope: only the flows that traverse R6/R7 (outage_flows); every lossless_flows entry must keep 0 % loss for the whole window

baseline.rule: re-run every flow through the traffic runner <= 15 min before step 0 and after every step; historical runs never substitute

abort.procedure: stop at the current step; run that operation's rollback (acceptance.OPERATIONS); re-run `check ... --completed` until it equals the step-0 baseline digest; re-run every flow

rollback.BOOTSTRAP_AUTHORIZE: revoke the authorization (authorization.revoke); expiry closes it on its own
rollback.ISOLATION_ENFORCE: isolation release / restore of the recorded exact inverse (plan ops), upstream digest re-checked
rollback.ZTP_REBOOTSTRAP: restore the device's saved startup-config; the DHCP policy rollback (ztp.policy.rollback_policy)
rollback.DHCP_RENEWAL_WINDOW: window lapses on its own deadline; OVERDUE offers native-only recovery actions
rollback.COMMISSIONING_CONFIGURE: commissioning abort -> restore the device to its pre-commissioning digest
rollback.ADMISSION: failed verification restores the upstream byte-identical and re-verifies isolation (ADMISSION_VERIFICATION_FAILED)
rollback.MANAGEMENT_PATH_APPROVE: revoke the path (management.paths.revoke_path); the selector fails closed to the remaining paths

abort.restore: ZTP_REBOOTSTRAP: restore the saved startup-config recorded in restore_points (after the step-0 save), then DHCP policy rollback; ISOLATION_ENFORCE: exact-inverse release; ADMISSION failure restores the upstream byte-identical
